newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt says buys 200,000T U.S. wheat at $148-148.5.
newsitem.headline: Egypt says buys 200,000T U.S. wheat at $148-148.5.

text.p: Egypt's official commodities buyer said on Sunday he bought 200,000 tonnes of soft red wheat from the United States at prices ranging from $148 to $148.5 per tonne for delivery in June.
Samir el-Shakankiri, vice chairman for the General Authority for Supply Commodities, told Reuters it had bought the wheat in the following four lots:
-- 50,000 tonnes at $148 per tonne from Continental grain for delivery from 20 to 30 June.
-- 50,000 tonnes at $148.25 from Beavey for delivery from 10 to 25 June.
-- 50,000 tonnes at $148.25 from Nedera Amber for delivery from 20 to 30 June.
-- 50,000 tonnes at $148.5 from Beavey for delivery from 20 to 28 June.
